  Scenario: AC6 A decision record that cannot be written moves nothing and fails the run (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the decision record of one hop cannot be written
    When the harness runs the journey for business date 2026-11-25
    Then the state change, the record and the outbox row of that hop are not written
    And the run is reported failed and is never reported passed
    And MSG-P7-003 is the message the owning service returns and the report names it

  Scenario: AC7 A role without the right calls a hop and is refused (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a role without the right calls a hop
    When the harness calls the hop through POST /api/recovery/access/v1/authorise
    Then the hop is refused with MSG-P4-002 and nothing is written
    And the personal fields of the answer are masked

  Scenario: AC8 A stale ACE data product is never read as today's (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given an ACE data product behind a hop carries the previous business date
    When the harness runs the journey for business date 2026-11-25
    Then the hop does not treat the stale product as today's and the run fails
    And the report names the product, the date it carries and MSG-P1-001
